description: Catalog of AI API keys with env var mappings. Generated by apply scripts from decrypted system.yml; consumed by sops.nix and ai.nix at Nix evaluation time.

keys.description: List of AI API key entries. Each entry maps a SOPS secret name to the environment variable it should be exported as.

name.description: SOPS secret name with key_ prefix (e.g. key_ai_openrouter).

envVar.description: Environment variable name: the SOPS key name uppercased (key_ai_foo → KEY_AI_FOO).
